elevationMeaning: Highest source sample in each cell, rounded up (max pooling; never averaged). Metres above the EGM2008 geoid (about mean sea level). Surface model: includes vegetation and structures. Open-sea tiles are not published (treat as 0 m).

regions.name: French Polynesia (Tahiti)
regions.accuracyNote: Copernicus under-reads sharp tropical peaks here (Mont Orohena ~1,840 m vs 2,241 m real, about 400 m / 1,300 ft low). Do not rely on a 1,000 ft buffer over the interior of the islands.
